Purpose: Review data lineage, frozen sample selection, evidence interfaces and the paired worker before the formal CPU experiment.

Environment.reviewer: ChatGPT data implementation subagent with a separate worker peer-review task
Environment.review_mode: Static source reading plus local standard-library synthetic fixtures only
Environment.independence: The reviewer authored data_prepare.py and test_data.py. Worker code was authored by another agent in the same ChatGPT session. This is internal cross-review, not external or fully independent validation.

development_report.scope: Synthetic fixtures; not formal target-machine evidence

Expected.data: Rebuild frozen metadata from pinned original inputs, exclude the union of previously used sources, select the first16 remaining article_ids, preserve source bytes, and emit exactly128 body tokens per selected article without special tokens.
Expected.duplicates: Reject repeated selected prefixes and any selected128-token prefix equal to an old or corrected input prefix even when article identities differ.
Expected.worker_interface: Require PASS data completion with16 samples and32-call budget, bind the private input bytes by hash, and independently validate prefix hashes, order and source identities.
Expected.runtime_boundary: No formal model call in this review. The worker is limited to32 adaptive calls under the frozen threshold and saves evidence before stopping on any BLOCKED or FAIL.

resolved_findings.finding: Source disjointness and within-cohort uniqueness did not initially exclude a new article with the same128-token prefix as a historical input.
resolved_findings.resolution: Added a pre-emission check against the union of all old and corrected sample tokens[:128] hashes, without substituting a different article or changing the selection rule.

static_checks.check: Original parquet/tokenizer/ledger/partition/old and corrected inputs/selection-change and frozen helper pins are checked before reconstruction; original source byte identities are preserved after the data stage.

The old formula-fragment row maps to its canonical parent article. Old31 and corrected32 unique sources form an excluded33-source union. The remaining27 candidates are ordered by article_id, with the first16 selected before model results exist.

The worker binds data/public/completion.json by SHA, requires Status PASS and16/32 counts, verifies the private input artifact hash, and validates128-token length, token types/range, unique source identities, source order and both prefix hash encodings.

The canonical input_ids hash covers the token list without a batch dimension. The worker separately checks runtime batch-shaped JSON and raw int64 tensor bytes, avoiding confusion between these encodings.
Worker loops over16 articles and seeds3101/3202, limits calls to32, invokes only the frozen adaptive API, and checks equal-length same-seed h0/RNG pairing.

Frozen state_snapshot compares all63 state entries byte-for-byte with the original checkpoint; finite-value checks, runtime settings, frozen controller threshold, observed call counts and model/config/source/package preservation remain enforced.
BLOCKED/FAIL paths stop subsequent model calls. Post-stop preservation reads/hashes the existing state only. Final PASS depends on complete32-call coverage and successful preservation.
Public data and worker artifacts expose metadata and hashes; token arrays, original input text and raw numerical tensors remain in private target artifacts.

limitations: Static checks and synthetic fixtures do not establish successful target corpus reconstruction, target dependency compatibility or model execution.
Novelty is limited to the existing Parcae depth/routing inputs. Earlier project usage and pretraining overlap are not ruled out.
Observed early exits would establish routing behavior in this sample, not preserved language quality, net acceleration or population generalization.
The same internal team implemented and reviewed this stage; no external independent audit is claimed.

status_scope: Static review and the recorded synthetic development fixtures only
